d: We are looking for a customer-focused, strategic, and results-driven Customer Solutions Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding customer needs, developing effective solutions, managing customer relationships, and ensuring the successful delivery of services that meet client expectations.

The successful candidate will work closely with customers and internal teams to identify business challenges, recommend tailored solutions, resolve service-related issues, and drive customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term business growth.
Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
Understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational challenges.
Identify customer pain points and recommend effective, customized solutions.
Act as a key point of contact for customer-related matters and solution delivery.
Collaborate with sales, operations, technical, and support teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
Oversee the implementation and execution of customer solutions from initial discussions through delivery.
Monitor customer satisfaction, engagement, and overall service performance.
Address customer concerns, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of issues.
Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, service quality, and operational efficiency.
Develop customer success strategies to improve retention and strengthen relationships.
Evaluate solution effectiveness and recommend improvements based on customer feedback and performance data.
Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding existing customer relationships.
Prepare customer performance reports, solution proposals, and management updates.
Ensure customer requirements are communicated effectively to relevant internal teams.
Stay updated on industry trends, customer expectations, and emerging service solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Information Technology, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in Customer Solutions, Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a similar role.
Strong understanding of customer relationship management and service delivery processes.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Experience in managing customer expectations, escalations, and service-related challenges.
Ability to understand customer business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
Familiarity with CRM platforms and customer management tools.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
Strong leadership, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and priorities effectively.
Experience in developing customer-focused business solutions.
Knowledge of customer journey management and customer experience optimization.
Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho.
Understanding of customer retention, satisfaction, and loyalty strategies.
Experience in preparing proposals, presentations, and solution documentation.
Strong understanding of service-level agreements (SLAs) and performance metrics.
Ability to identify business growth opportunities through customer relationships.
Professional growth and career advancement opportunities.
Opportunity to work with diverse customers and business challenges.
Exposure to strategic customer management and business solution development initiatives.
Head of Technology - Permanent - Banking / fintech / Financial Services
Location: Doha, Qatar | Full-tim e | On-Site
Salt is partnering with a growing financial services business to appoint a Head of Technology.
This is an opportunity to take ownership of the technology function, shaping its strategy and ensuring the business has the systems, infrastructure and capabilities to support continued growth.

The role requires a commercially minded technology leader with experience across software development, infrastructure, production operations and cybersecurity. You will combine strategic direction with practical delivery, working closely with senior stakeholders and external partners.
q: li
Proven technology leadership experience within digital banking, lending or a related regulated financial services environment.
li
Broad technical knowledge spanning applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity and live operations.
li
Experience scaling technology platforms and managing complex integrations.
li
A track record of leading internal teams and external technology partners.
li
Strong judgement, with the ability to balance delivery speed, resilience, security and cost.
li
Confidence engaging senior stakeholders and translating technical decisions into clear business outcomes.
li
A practical, adaptable approach and the ability to take ownership in a growing business.
li
Regional market experience would be advantageous.
p
This position is based full-time in Doha, Qatar. Candidates must be based locally or willing to relocate.
p
For a confidential discussion, please contact Salt or submit your CV. Further details will be shared during the recruitment process.
r: Define and deliver the technology strategy in line with business priorities.
Lead the development and operation of secure, scalable and reliable technology platforms.
Oversee architecture, engineering, cloud infrastructure, integrations and production environments.
Strengthen system availability, performance, incident management and business continuity.
Work with security, risk and compliance teams to maintain appropriate controls and meet regulatory requirements.
Manage technology vendors and delivery partners, ensuring service quality and value.
Build and develop internal technology capabilities, establishing clear ownership and delivery standards.
Own technology budgets, resource planning and investment priorities.
Partner with business leaders to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
